description: Regional statistics from BPS tables: the indicator ids with unit, level (province or kabupaten/kota), every period available, source table and caveats. Includes unemployment (TPT), poverty and poverty lines, HDI (IPM), wages, population, GRDP per capita, life expectancy and monthly inflation and CPI (inflation_mom, inflation_yoy, inflation_ytd, cpi for provinces; inflation_yoy_regency for CPI cities; periods YYYY-MM from 2024-01, base 2022=100). Start here, then call get_stat_values or get_stat_series.
name: list_stat_indicators
